description:
Money isn’t the goal.
Freedom is.

Freedom from pressure.
Freedom from survival mode.
Freedom to work on who you’re becoming…not just what you’re producing.
transcript: Greatest gift money can give you, it's not the Lamborghini, it's not the travel, it's not the plane. It's because it'll take away the pressure to give you a moment to become the man you're meant to be, not the one you're pretending to be.
